description: Source code implementing a test harness for hash map performance testing, including functions for creating hash entries, computing hashes with different methods, and executing performance tests based on command input.

methods.name: test_entry_cmp
methods.description: Comparison function for test entries, optionally ignoring case based on cmp_data.

methods.name: alloc_test_entry
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new test_entry with given hash, key, and value.

methods.name: hash
methods.description: Computes hash value based on selected method, index, and key.

methods.name: perf_hashmap
methods.description: Performs performance testing of hashmap add and lookup operations based on method and rounds.

methods.name: cmd__hashmap
methods.description: Main command function that reads commands from stdin and executes hashmap performance tests.
